summary: A diary can call a day memorable without yet saying what it will turn out to mean.
realLife: George Templeton Strong closed election day 1860 by calling it a memorable day, without saying yet what it would be remembered for.
sources: House Divided, Dickinson College, George Templeton Strong's diary, election day 6 Nov 1860: https://hd.housedivided.dickinson.edu/node/34626
inGame: The `mine` move for a writer with `stand-unsure`; the old memoir-revise move can later say what it came to mean.
